# Security policy

livecap handles live audio of real people and API keys for LiveKit and speech-to-text services. Please report vulnerabilities privately.

## Reporting

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting: **Security → Report a vulnerability** on this repository. Do not open a public issue.

Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and the impact you expect. You will get an answer within 7 days.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release on `main` receives fixes while the project is pre-1.0.
